faq.q: What makes a good heart urchin name?
faq.a: A good heart urchin name should match your pet's personality, be easy to pronounce and remember, and ideally be one or two syllables.

faq.q: Should I choose a name based on appearance?
faq.a: Absolutely! Distinctive features make wonderful naming inspiration.

faq.q: Can I use a human name?
faq.a: Human names are very popular for pets and can make the bond feel more personal.

faq.q: How many names should I consider?
faq.a: Shortlist 3-5 favorites and test them over a few days.

faq.q: Do heart urchins respond to certain sounds?
faq.a: Animals respond best to names ending in vowel sounds, especially 'ee' sounds.
